qa_pairs.question: How do you submit an Abaqus explicit analysis job for version 2026 or newer on a single compute node using a project directory script?
qa_pairs.answer: To submit an Abaqus explicit analysis job for version 2026 or newer on a single compute node, use the command `abaqus job=testep1 input=myexp-sim.inp scratch=$SLURM_TMPDIR cpus=$SLURM_CPUS_ON_NODE interactive mp_mode=threads memory="$((${SLURM_MEM_PER_NODE}-3072))MB"`. This command specifies the job name, input file, scratch directory, number of CPUs, interactive mode, threading mode, and memory allocation.

qa_pairs.question: How can a user configure an Abaqus explicit analysis job to write restart data for a specific number of time increments?
qa_pairs.answer: To configure an Abaqus explicit analysis job to write restart data for a total of 12 time increments, you must specify the following in the input file: `*RESTART, WRITE, OVERLAY, NUMBER INTERVAL=12, TIME MARKS=NO`.
